Plain decimal 1..100 bounds for 197A and spaced decimal 0..1000000, n+m>0 for 626C are unambiguous. No required image, interaction, special checker, or floating tolerance.

independentAssessment.derivation: For tallest height H, Hall conditions reduce to floor(H/2)>=n, floor(H/3)>=m, floor(H/2)+floor(H/3)-floor(H/6)>=n+m. The positive union slots repeat at offsets 2,3,4,6 in each block of six. Its S-th slot is 6*((S-1)//4)+(2,3,4,6)[(S-1)%4]. Answer is maximum of this slot, 2n and 3m; this closed form is independently derived, unlike worker binary search.
